features: Certified Whale OS with Voice Assistant and Screen Sharing: The ENKART Vibe Pro Projector runs on Widevine L1-certified Whale OS, offering a smooth and secure smart TV experience with built-in Voice Assistant for convenient hands-free control. Easily cast or mirror content wirelessly from your smartphone, tablet, or laptop. With ChatGPT integration, you can access smart assistance, real-time information, and personalized content suggestions, transforming the Vibe Pro into a versatile all-in-one smart entertainment hub

Native 1080P Resolution with 1000 ANSI Lumens and Fully Automatic Setup: Experience stunning Full HD clarity with Native 1080P resolution, delivering sharp details, vibrant colors, and an immersive viewing experience. With 1000 ANSI Lumens of brightness and HDR/HLG support, enjoy enhanced contrast and lifelike visuals. The fully automatic setup, including Auto Focus and Auto Keystone Correction, makes it quick and effortless to get a perfectly aligned picture every time

Sealed Optical Engine for Long-Lasting Picture Quality: The ENKART Yuva Vibe Pro features a sealed optical engine that helps protect the internal LCD and optical components from dust and airborne particles. This minimizes dust accumulation inside the projection system, helping maintain clear, bright and consistent image quality while reducing the need for internal cleaning and maintenance

270 Degree Rotatable Design with HDMI ARC and Bluetooth Remote: The built-in 270 degree rotatable design offers exceptional placement flexibility, allowing you to project from a table, tripod, or other suitable positions to achieve the viewing angle you need. With HDMI ARC, connect seamlessly to compatible soundbars and home theater systems for an enhanced audio experience. The Bluetooth Remote provides smooth, responsive control without the need to point directly at the projector, making navigation effortless from virtually any direction

2-Way Bluetooth and Dual-Band Wi-Fi with Built-in 12W Speaker: Experience fast, stable, and seamless connectivity with dual-band Wi-Fi, designed for smoother streaming and responsive online gaming. Enjoy your favorite 4K content with minimal buffering and reliable performance. With 2-Way Bluetooth, the Vibe Pro lets you effortlessly connect wireless headphones, speakers, soundbars, keyboards, and other compatible devices, or use it as a Bluetooth speaker for added versatility. The powerful built-in 12W speaker delivers rich, room-filling audio, eliminating the need for external speakers for everyday entertainment
